reserveReview.rationale: Refresh 2026-08-28: Tori's live proof-of-solvency API reported at 2026-08-27T22:01:01.141Z total reserves of $66,273,406.18 against $66,154,991.59 total supply (100.179% gross coverage), with money markets 62.94%, delta-neutral futures arbitrage 26.89%, cash and equivalents held as FX collateral 10.00%, and on-chain buffer 0.17%. Accountable independently verifies liabilities from the trUSD contract and asset values from custodian and venue data connectors on a 15-minute cadence using Merkle-root, enclave, and zero-knowledge proofs. Because the strategy-level percentages are independently attested and sum to the reported reserve total, the reserve split is treated as verified; the undisclosed custodian/venue identities and unpublished reserve-fund size are captured as risk factors and in the coin notice rather than as unknown reserve exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Timestamped Tori proof-of-solvency API asset-distribution snapshot; Accountable proof-of-solvency methodology; Tori strategy and institutional docs; verified ToriMinting contract source and independent on-chain flow tracing of the custodian wallet.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Custodian bank, investment-bank, and execution-venue identities are undisclosed by policy, venue-level allocations and leverage are unpublished, and the size of the protocol reserve fund is undisclosed; the attested split cannot be independently reconciled against the on-chain flows, which terminate at exchange deposit addresses and an unlabeled wallet. These gaps affect custody/counterparty risk assessment, not the verified strategy-level composition split. The 0.17% on-chain buffer also combines USDC and USDT without component weights.
